req.title: Emit Swagger UI
req.statement: The system shall serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should serve interactive Swagger UI documentation at GET /docs. This is a critical feature for API observability, allowing developers to explore and understand the API endpoints. The test suite includes a positive test to verify the successful retrieval of the Swagger UI, a negative test to handle incorrect paths, and a boundary test to ensure the correct handling of the /docs endpoint.

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_positive
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint.
expected: The response content should include Swagger UI HTML.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_negative
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to a non-existent /docs-invalid endpoint.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs-invalid')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_swagger_ui_boundary
preconditions: The FastAPI application is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /docs endpoint with a trailing slash.
expected: The response content should include Swagger UI HTML.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/docs/')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert '<title>Swagger UI</title>' in response.text
